name: package-registry
description: Query npm and PyPI package metadata. Look up the latest version, description, license, and homepage of a package, or list its published versions. Keyless — no credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: pkg.npm_info
tools.description: Get metadata for an npm package: latest version, description, license, homepage, deprecation status, and maintainer count.

name.description: npm package name, e.g. express or @scope/pkg

tools.name: pkg.npm_versions
tools.description: List published versions of an npm package, sorted oldest to newest, returning the most recent N.

name.description: npm package name, e.g. express or @scope/pkg

limit.description: Max recent versions to return (default 20, max 100)

tools.name: pkg.pypi_info
tools.description: Get metadata for a PyPI package: latest version, summary, license, homepage, required Python version, and yanked status.

tools.name: pkg.pypi_versions
tools.description: List released versions of a PyPI package (only those with published files), sorted oldest to newest, returning the most recent N.

limit.description: Max recent versions to return (default 20, max 100)
